storyInfo: After being released from jail, the washerwoman Tonya decides to bring attention to the strange illness by blowing up the wall, but her reckless action is stopped by Crownslayer. A trained band of Infected is gathering in secret. Raidian falls unconscious during the Doctor's intelligence summary, while Sirka's assassination attempt on the Generalik fails.

attributes.content: This is your last warning, Tonya.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: You'll be dealt with harshly, if you're caught spreading rumors and inciting panic again. You'd better stay on the straight and narrow!
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: <p=1>First District Apartments, Zelgrad</><p=2> Jan 20, 1102, 17:40</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Doing it by day doesn't work. I'll have to...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Are you alright, Tonya?
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Resident

attributes.content: Mark? Were you waiting for me?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: We all saw the way the soldier grabbed you downstairs. Did they throw you in jail again?
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: You shouldn't do this... think of your family.
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: All those things you keep talking about every day, there's no proof at all.
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: Yeah. More importantly, are you hurt? I just came back from the clinic. We'll have to go back if you're injured.
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Resident

attributes.content: I'm fine. Were you at the clinic, Mark? What did Nadezhda say? Is my sister getting better?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Her condition's holding stable right now. No need to be too worried.
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Resident

attributes.content: It was my fault for bringing back the work jacket to wash at home. How could I—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Let the government folks worry about any strange illnesses. We just take care of ourselves.
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: We'll have a barbecue and celebrate once your sister gets better!
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: Great! I just made sausages!
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Resident

attributes.content: Finally! I haven't had them in ages. I started to miss them my second day here—
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: But I haven't found Kirill yet...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: See? This is all good stuff. I just cut a couple, and my hands are already all greasy.
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Resident

attributes.content: They'll taste so good cooked in soup. My mouth's already watering...
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: Guys! I haven't seen Kirill for days, and no one answers when I knock on his door. None of you have seen him either, have you?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: This is no joke! This is no time to relax.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: ...Didn't we already tell you, Tonya?
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Resident

attributes.content: You're pushing yourself too hard.
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Resident

attributes.content: I—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Did you forget that Kirill just lost his wife and kid? I guess staying in this place brings back bad memories.
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: Maybe he left Zelgrad and went home.
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: It's unusual that he didn't say goodbye to us, but you can't just assume he's missing, or that it has anything to do with your sister's illness...
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: Surely the police will come if something's not right.
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: Are we just going to pretend that nothing's happening? You saw the strange spots and bruises on Nina—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: And that's all there is, a little bit of rash. Happens all the time in this environment and weather. A little bit of rest is all it takes.
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Resident

attributes.content: You said it's the clothes of those white coats, but I've been washing the same clothes, and there's nothing wrong with me.
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Resident

attributes.content: With a smile, he puts a hand on Tonya's shoulder. Faint green spots are visible underneath the tiny hairs.
Tonya jumps, causing the others to look at each other in confusion as she struggles to explain her actions.
...Tonya?
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Resident

attributes.content: Well, she's under a lot of stress.
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: Look, Tonya, I know you have our best interests in your hearts, but it's best if you don't talk about those strange things anymore.
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: We're so happy here. Living in Zelgrad is like springtime compared to life elsewhere in Ursus. We should cherish it.
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: We'll go and see Nina tomorrow, then pick up the other kids from school. Have a good meal, drink to your heart's content, and forget all those things, alright?
attributes.name: Concerned Resident

attributes.content: That's right, Tonya.
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Resident

attributes.content: Things will get better.
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Resident

attributes.content: Night falls, and a stiff silence comes upon the city.
A dark shadow vaults over the wall, arriving at an abandoned warehouse, avoiding the things scattered on the ground on tiptoes.
...Good, the stuff's all here.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I can't wait. Tomorrow has to be the day—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: The day for what?
—Who's there?!
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: ...Who are you... ugh—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Quiet, unless you want your arm broken.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: W-Who are you? What do you know?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Y-You're interfering with the Reunion! My comrades will have your head!
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Enough bluffing. I've been following you, and I can tell that you and your 'comrades' have nothing to do with the Reunion.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Five bottles of flammable liquid, a bundle of Originium explosives... the Reunion isn't dumb enough to attack a gate guarded by the First Army with just this.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: ...I didn't think it would defeat them. But what they're doing behind those walls must have something to do with the strange events that have been happening lately.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: So you want to blow a hole in the wall, set a fire, get people's attention.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You think the things the Army's hiding in the labs will come to light if you make enough of a commotion.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: But these cans and bottles are all the preparation you've made...
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You haven't even investigated what that wall's made of.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: A wall is a wall! Stone or steel, what else could it be? If it could be made, it could be destroyed.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: You think you can set the explosives under the patrols' noses, when I managed to pin you to the ground by myself?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I practiced! I'm prepared!
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Did you practice on location? You think you can deploy and detonate it at a range that they won't find out?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You don't understand! You never saw—you don't know that all of Zelgrad is now in danger from some unknown source. I need to get people's attention, even if—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: You still don't understand?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You're facing the First Army. Fighting them by yourself is futile.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Your 'comrades' are just ordinary people whose eyes aren't open yet. No one is truly on your side.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Besides, how can you be sure that the incidents have something to do with the experiments behind the wall? You know the experiments exist, but you have no inkling about the details...
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: How do you intend to explain to the people once you've gotten their attention?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: ...At least, I have to make them look up...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: You want them to look. How about we look at the present? Forget your neighbors. Do your closest family fully believe what you're saying?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Will you come and pick me up today, Tonya?
attributes.name: Sobbing Girl

attributes.content: I don't want to stay at Uncle Mark's house anymore. It's not our home, and I don't want to bother them...
attributes.name: Sobbing Girl

attributes.content: ...I'll take you out to picnic once spring comes and Nina has gotten better, alright?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Has Nina gotten better? You've been so busy, we hardly see you other than bedtime.
attributes.name: Sobbing Girl

attributes.content: It's like you're not around even when you're at home. We have to call your name several times to get you to answer. You're not at the table or in bed—
attributes.name: Sobbing Girl

attributes.content: You don't hug us any more. Why?
attributes.name: Sobbing Girl

attributes.content: What are you doing, Tonya...
attributes.name: Sobbing Girl

attributes.content: But what else can I do? I...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I tried everything I could think of. Nina's still in the clinic. That strange bruising might have spread already. I don't even dare go and see her—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: What can I do...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Calmed down a little?
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You... you sound like you know Reunion well.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: That's not important.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You want to know what you can do? There's always one thing, and only one thing—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Find more evidence.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: More evidence...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: You need more evidence to prove that your sister's condition is not an isolated incident, and that it could affect everyone.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Convince them that this is a matter of life and death to them. Only then would they listen to you.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Let go, Valiya.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: (Whisper) There's a soldier with them.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Thank you...
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: What—
attributes.name: Serious Soldier

attributes.content: Oh, I forgot, somebody has moved into the second floor.
attributes.name: Serious Soldier

attributes.content: Follow me.
attributes.name: Serious Soldier

attributes.content: Did you also arrive in Zelgrad today?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: We—
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: That's enough chit-chat.
attributes.name: Serious Soldier

attributes.content: You'll be working in the same district, there's plenty of time for you to talk then. Let's go.
attributes.name: Serious Soldier

attributes.content: Who's coming with me to registration?
attributes.name: Serious Soldier

attributes.content: Excuse me, I have a question... if there are other people on the second floor, while the first floor is the security room and public spaces, where do the rest of us stay?
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: There are three of us who are not yet housed.
attributes.name: Anxious Miner

attributes.content: Can't you squeeze in? Or I could take them to another building.
attributes.name: Serious Soldier

attributes.content: But maybe there'll be room here in a few days...
attributes.name: Serious Soldier

attributes.content: (In a few days...?)
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: What's your plan?
attributes.name: Serious Soldier

attributes.content: The youth exchanges a glance with the miner and shakes head at the soldier.
We'll find a way to squeeze in.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: 'Has it lathered up yet?'
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: 'The blade's still hot.'

attributes.content: Excuse me... excuse me.
attributes.name: Tardy Worker

attributes.content: Sorry, those guys were a pain! Team A should be all present now.
attributes.name: Tardy Worker

attributes.content: Captain Pavel!
attributes.name: Tardy Worker

attributes.content: The man gives the miner at the front a crooked salute.
(Nods)
attributes.name: Pavel

attributes.content: Good work, lads.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: We had been operating according to the original plan, but we realized we had lost contact with your group after we found a good gathering spot. If you didn't find a way to reestablish communication...
attributes.name: Pavel

attributes.content: Good thing we had the contingency. What's the current situation here?
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: This location is temporary. The residential layer is connected to the apartments and some districts. Land is at a premium in the satellite city, and this place isn't likely to remain abandoned for long based on the frequency of patrols.
attributes.name: Pavel

attributes.content: We can't stay too long. I have an idea what you're trying to do and I support you, but you should explain it to the others. We'll get this done quickly.
attributes.name: Pavel

attributes.content: Alright.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Everybody, listen up.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Our primary objective is to ascertain what's going on here, then try to find the Infected who came before us but seem to have gone off the grid.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Something's clearly off about this place. There is surveillance everywhere. Things are even harder than the last time we entered a nomadic city.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: We still need a few more days to plot the patrol routes, but we already understand that the Infected in the satellite city are separately housed.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: That's the question that I want to discuss—we've passed through many towns and villages, but never before have we seen soldiers patrolling the streets and residences with such frequency.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: There were more guards around our apartments than there were on the streets along the way. That alone is suspicious enough.
attributes.name: Perplexed Miner

attributes.content: Right, that's why I decided to test them while there was still daylight.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: This is your last warning! Not one step further!
attributes.name: Nervous Guard
Calm Youth
attributes.content: Sorry, sir, I didn't mean to—

attributes.name: Calm Youth
attributes.content: we just did a head count, and some people were missing. We were concerned that they might get into trouble wandering around the city.
You can't go through here! Give me their names and descriptions, and the Army will find them.
attributes.name: Nervous Guard

attributes.content: Wait... I think that's—
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Karl! Is that you, Karl?
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: The soldier instinctively looks in the direction in which the youth is calling. The seemingly frail figure quickly slips underneath his arm and gets through.
Blyat! I need backup! Get that one!
attributes.name: Nervous Guard

attributes.content: More shouting and the rattling of boots, and the youth is quickly surrounded by a circle of black military uniforms.
Several hands reach out to grab those thin arms, but none of the soldiers pull their weapons, despite their fierce expressions.
That's dangerous! You should tell us before taking such risks.
attributes.name: Anxious Miner

attributes.content: Thank you, but the reason I dared to try was that I noticed that the soldiers weren't equipped with lethal weapons.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: And I was right. They seem unwilling to harm me for some reason.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: You mean they want to keep an eye on us, but not hurt us?
attributes.name: Perplexed Miner

attributes.content: Sounds like a glorified prison.
attributes.name: Perplexed Miner

attributes.content: Worse. We have soldiers instead of prison guards, and we know nothing about what the Army's intentions are.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Perhaps this intention is the reason why they've suddenly opened their doors to the Infected.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Uh—
attributes.name: Perplexed Miner

attributes.content: ...I've been talking to the local Infected all afternoon.
attributes.name: Hesitant Miner

attributes.content: They said most of the Infected are under the care of the Army and housed in designated apartments.
attributes.name: Hesitant Miner

attributes.content: Prior to that, however, they were sent to a local clinic, where the doctors don't care whether you're Infected, and accept the factory scrips that only circulate in the industrial districts.
attributes.name: Hesitant Miner

attributes.content: You mean those paper-thin metal plates that are only seen in this place?
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Yes, some of us who came in earlier got it yesterday. Strangely enough, wages here are issued daily...
attributes.name: Hesitant Miner

attributes.content: Anyway, after Zelgrad's recent Infected policies were introduced, everyone assumes that clinic is working with the Army.
attributes.name: Hesitant Miner

attributes.content: Maybe collecting data for them for Oripathy research? If the Army's really holding us like prisoners, then this so-called clinic...
attributes.name: Hesitant Miner

attributes.content: ...I see. Good work.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: The clinic sounds suspicious. We should investigate.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Go back and prepare, wait for my word. Be discreet when moving weapons.
attributes.name: Calm Youth

attributes.content: Alright!
attributes.name: Everyone

attributes.options: Have you finished your checks?;We'll talk once the room is secure.

attributes.content: No problems. The room's clean, no surveillance or recording equipment.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: I put jammers by the wall, just in case. It's one-time, but it'll be useful until they find out.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: The soldiers said the Marshal of the First Army is treating Rhodes Island like VIPs, arranging the best accommodations and heavy security...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: In other words, we're being watched.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: So the soldiers outside the hotel...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.options: Probably here to keep an eye on us.;They must be hiding something.

attributes.content: Yeah, everything feels so eerie here.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Like that woman who stopped us at the transfer area earlier today!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.options: She was talking about 'dust never seen before that infects people'.
But there are already a lot of Infected living here.

attributes.content: Unless... she wasn't talking about Originium dust or Oripathy.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: If there's another illness that we're not aware of...
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Could it be a new symptom of Oripathy? I remember that Raidian raised a hypothesis in her report about why news of Infected mutation first spread from the Far North.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Even though we know now that it was likely a ruse by the Grand Duchess, wouldn't those involved have come to the conclusion of Oripathy mutations too?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: As was the case the last time, we can't jump to a conclusion until we learn more.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I tried asking questions during the day, but the locals don't want to talk.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Or rather, they're quite happy to talk, but as soon as you ask whether there has been anything unusual going on, they either ignore the question, or fall silent altogether.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: The officer who led the way was the same. He reminded me not to have too much contact with the locals.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Was it for our own safety, or something else?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: Remember the buildings hidden behind the wall?;What the Army is trying to hide is probably in the buildings behind the wall.

attributes.content: The locals don't know what's behind the wall either. It's like an entirely different city to them.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: It's strange. It seems like the First Army's research doesn't rely on the Infected here for labor—why do they do this, then?
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: The open areas of Zelgrad are no different from the average nomadic city. The First Army's research institute must lie behind the wall.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Based on the officer's reaction, the letter of safe passage from Chairman Witte isn't enough to get us through that wall.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: And we've heard nothing from the Marshal who was supposed to welcome us.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: Grypherburg has no reason to deceive us.;Grypherburg doesn't control the First Army.
Zelgrad is particularly warm.;It's like spring.

attributes.content: Is that so? I didn't quite feel it.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: I noticed too... this sort of weather is not normal.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Doctor, do you remember about the mysterious new bomb that Hellagur mentioned?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: It might have something to do with the Sarcophagus... we need more information, and quickly.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: We've got just the right woman for the job—you up for it, Raidian?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Yes, I should be able to intercept some of the communications.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: The code the USSG obtained which Dur-nar sent us is used by large military installations. These facilities often send electrical signals at a specific frequency.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: What do you think, Doctor?
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Here we go—
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: The crack of static electricity echoes through the empty room.
Everyone present has seen Raidian's Arts many times, but they cannot help but hold their breath, watching her furrowed brows and twitching lips.
(Whisper) Raidian, are you really gonna be okay?
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: (Whisper) Trust her, she's master—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Ugh—argh!
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Raidian barely took a step before stumbling and falling.
Raidian—
attributes.name: Everyone

attributes.content: Overload! I brought emergency meds. Hang in there, Raidian!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Ugh...
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Electric-magnetic radiation... here...
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Raidian!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: The night is deathly silent, except for the echoing of orderly footsteps in the distance, magnified by the emptiness.
There was food and clean water in the break room by the sentry post prior to the shift change in the patrols in this district, a perk that other units do not enjoy.

Ever since the Generalik returned to Zelgrad, they occasionally got off an hour or two early, and extra supplies began appearing in the break room, which they were even allowed to bring home to their families.
No one knew why. No one asked, because why would they mess with a good thing while it lasts?
Nor did anyone suspect that the foodstuff had been tampered with. Tonight, someone has made sure that they would not leave the break room for a while after their usual little feast.
(Their replacements should appear in four minutes, based on the patrol routes.)
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: (Even if Anatoliy doesn't show up personally, his bodyguards should be here to 'act in his capacity'.)
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Mmph—mmph!
attributes.name: Panicked Soldier

attributes.content: Have you thought it over? You can talk if you have, or you can join your comrades on the floor.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: (Nods frantically)
attributes.name: Panicked Soldier

attributes.content: Hff... ha—
attributes.name: Panicked Soldier

attributes.content: Was it the Generalik's unit who replaced you today?
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: I-I've never seen them, I don't know—
attributes.name: Panicked Soldier

attributes.content: (Raises hand)
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: We don't know who takes over the shifts! We get notified to stop at the sentry post, and that someone will take over the next shift, but no one tells us who's taking over.
attributes.name: Panicked Soldier

attributes.content: Although, it will certainly make sense if it was the Generalik...
attributes.name: Panicked Soldier

attributes.content: What if it isn't?
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Then there should be another unit on patrol, but everyone's schedule is packed, and no one can be in two places at the same time.
attributes.name: Panicked Soldier

attributes.content: Unless there's a unit that's not on the shift schedule—the Generalik's bodyguards.
attributes.name: Panicked Soldier

attributes.content: What do you mean?
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: It could only be his bodyguards. If he doesn't show up personally, his bodyguards would be patrolling on his behalf.
attributes.name: Panicked Soldier

attributes.content: (Quietly) He's here.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: ...How's the fuel?
attributes.name: Young Voice

attributes.content: As you commanded.
attributes.name: Low Voice

attributes.content: Is there enough?
attributes.name: Young Voice

attributes.content: There have not been any reports about shortages.
attributes.name: Low Voice

attributes.content: Keep an eye on them. Our people need to be involved in every step. There must be no mistake...
attributes.name: Young Voice

attributes.content: You should understand.
attributes.name: Young Voice

attributes.content: The source of the young voice appears in Sirka's field of vision.
She has never seen the Generalik before, but she is certain that she has found him.
The tyrant of Zelgrad, the only son of the First Army's marshal...
(Softly) Anatoliy Svetlanov Buterin.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Gazing upon the malicious visage illuminated by the flickering searchlight, so reminiscent of the Marshal's younger days, Sirka clutches her dagger and hides herself in the darkness.

The guards around her mark do not matter. The unfamiliar girl next to him does not matter. All that matters is the spot that her blade needs to find, the neck, the heart, or one of the arteries, where a single well-placed stab will kill—
She is ready, as she has been so many times before. But she did not expect the prey to detect her.
—Who's there?!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Huh?
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Anatoliy—
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: But Originium Arts have set up the perfect environment for the assassin, and the prey's awareness cannot stop the killer's blade.
A sudden breeze rustles clothes and masks the approaching footsteps, the leap, and the sound of dagger ripping through air—
Sorry, Generalik.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: I need to 'borrow' your life.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: The bodyguards have detected the intruder, even without hearing her sound.
But the weapon has already pierced the target's neck, and withdrawn as slickly as it went in.
Sirka is not in a hurry to escape. Without a pause, she proceeds to make her next stab, only to realize that there is no blood flowing from the first wound.
What—
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: It seems she has simply cut a gap in some kind of hard, golden substance.
It does not even look human.
Ugh...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: What... is this?
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: How could this be? I had—
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: There's the assassin! Get her!
attributes.name: Excited Soldier

attributes.content: After her... hurry—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: After her!!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: After her! Don't let her get away!
attributes.name: Excited Soldier

attributes.content: You two, stay here and protect the Generalik and Hierda! The rest of you, with me!
attributes.name: Excited Soldier

attributes.content: Generalik, your injury—
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: ...Let me.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Let me see his wound...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: The girl lays her hands on the young man's neck.
There was a piece of Originium crystal hidden underneath the collar, which should have been ripped open along with the flesh around it to reveal the bone beneath.
Underneath her palms, however, the injury is less serious than first imagined.
...It seems the Originium has already begun to repair the wound. There's no need to worry.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: What did you say?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I said, it seems the Originium is repairing your wound. Are you in pain?
attributes.name: Hierda
Anatoliy
attributes.content: I don't feel anything. But that suka pierced my neck—

attributes.name: Anatoliy
attributes.content: I felt it!
I couldn't speak, couldn't make a sound... I felt like I had died.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Maybe she only cut the Originium crystal on the surface of your body. I'm sorry I wasn't able to stop the assassin...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Hah, what can you do? A sword would go right through you without even slowing down.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Maybe she did kill me. Maybe I would be a corpse, if not for you—your miracle.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I can tell the difference between having my skin cut and having the artery in my neck cut.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: It's not a miracle... *sigh*.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: What I want to know is, what does this mean? Does it mean I can't die? Not even after a thousand assassination attempts?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: And it's all because of you, even though you claim you can't save me, that you only remove my pain...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You're the real deal, my friend. You've saved me twice now...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Argh...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: The young man's voice grows weaker after his initial excitement. The repairing of his wound has drained him.
You need to rest.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Tell me, how can I repay...?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: He soon falls unconscious.
...I don't need repayment, Anatoliy.
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: I never have...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: Hierda looks up in the direction where the assassin escaped, soldiers in hot pursuit.
She recalls those eyes that she saw in the darkness, bright and calm.
Desperate and dangerous.
She was Infected too...
attributes.name: Hierda

attributes.content: How did it come to this? Is there anything I can do?
attributes.name: Hierda
